reviewPolicy.finding: No review requirement is enforced on gq-theme, and missing configuration is not evidence that none is required. The sole-owner authority model names vvaz, but gmarquesetr also holds admin and can push or merge without review. GitHub Actions is allowed to approve pull requests, so an approving review alone is not authentic human review identity. The authorized maintainers and the actual review policy remain an owner decision; this review invents neither.
